newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to tackle 129.78/82 congestion.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to tackle 129.78/82 congestion.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF need to wade through congestion at 129.78/82 to get a chance at the 130.14 peak, analysts said on Monday.

"It's hardly inspiring considering the performance of everywhere else," said Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking in London. "There's a bit of congestion at 129.78,82 which it needs to get over."
Once through there, notionnel would aim for the 130.14 high on May 21. "I don't think it will get above that," Ostwald said.
Notionnel were quoted at 129.64, up 24 basis points at 0756 GMT.
David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said the contract would aim for the May highs around 130.74,76, if 130.14 was pierced.
"I don't like the notionnel as much as Bunds," he said. "They are much more vulnerable to weakness."
Sneddon put support at 129.54 from price action, and then below there at the bottom of the gap at 129.48/46, a level which Ostwald concurred with.
"If it breaks down through 129.22, it will be very vulnerable," Sneddon said.
Ostwald put support next at 129.02/06, the lows from last Wednesday and Thursday.
At the short end, June Pibor were unchanged at 96.54. September Pibor, which were now trading with larger volumes and open interest, were quoted at 96.46, also unchanged.
"September Pibor posted a second inside day on Friday, failing to clear the immediate trend resistance at 96.49," technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a note.
"Upside potential is steadily diminishing -- 96.50 retracement might be tested, but the channel resistance at 96.56 appears safe for the near term," they said.
